Are you our new Associate Consultant within AI & Engineering?

Flexible and collaborative, we're not bound to any single technology or framework. You can read about some of our cases here: https://www.intellishore.dk/cases.

Our organization is structured around two tribes, Strategy & Transformation and AI & Engineering, working hand in hand on every project. We cross-staff dynamically, assembling cross-functional teams tailored to each project's needs. You'll be based in the AI & Engineering tribe.

As a collective of developers and strategists, we bring energy, expertise, and a passion for helping our clients succeed.

Read more about our team here: https://www.intellishore.dk/about

We realize that you are still learning and need support, but you also need responsibilities that will push you further and develop your skills in the realm of digital transformation and healthcare.

As you will be supporting our experienced consultants on multiple cases no day is the same, but here is what you can expect and what we are looking for:

Natural flair for relation-building, stakeholder management, and communication
Work with either data science and data engineering and a wide range of technologies such as Python, Azure, GenAI, ML, LLMs etc.
Academic background in e.g. IT, engineering, or economics from CBS, ITU, DTU, KU

Preferably you have approx. two years remaining of your studies

Development is at the core of Intellishore, and we have dedicated plans for each Intellishorian and internal academy sessions for upskilling and knowledge sharing. Exciting and challenging consultant role in strategic and technical client projects

A dynamic and entrepreneurial environment with ambitious colleagues

3 | Exciting industry

Unique opportunity to get a deep insight into the world of AI, Data & Analytics!

Strategic seminars (previous years we've been to Germany, Italy, UK, Iceland and France)

Everyone talks about having a lot of social events but we don't need it, we just love spending time together!

Every year all the Intellishorians leave behind their daily tasks to assemble for the annual Strategic Seminar to experience a change in scenery, strengthen their abilities to work together as a team, and gather inspiration to help set the overall direction of Intellishore and the work we do for our clients.

Just one more time. Why should I join Intellishore?

We are on an exciting journey to change the world of data and AI. We are entrepreneurial. We are a bit crazy. But we are also pretty cool. And nice. So, if you want to be part of an exciting journey with a bunch of crazy, but pretty cool and nice people, then don't hesitate to reach out. This is your opportunity to be part of something truly great.

Apply now

Joining Green Eagle means growing alongside the company and becoming part of the transformative mindset that defines us. 🚀

If you are encouraged to do great things, join our team! 🤝💚

The challenge:

Green Eagle builds mission-critical energy optimisation systems. Our platform processes real-time telemetry from renewable assets and integrates with control centres and grid operators through industrial protocols. When it degrades, energy production is affected directly. Reliability and delivery speed are not preferences here; they are constraints we design for.
As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will build and evolve our Internal Developer Platform: the foundation that lets engineering teams ship safely, quickly and autonomously. You will design the systems, workflows and abstractions that reduce cognitive load and make reliability, security and scalability the default rather than something each team solves again on its own.
The Platform team operates as a product team, and internal engineers are your customers. Your first months will go into understanding the current infrastructure, the delivery pipelines and where teams work around the platform instead of through it. From there, your impact will come from adoption and from measurable outcomes for the teams you serve, not from the sophistication of what you build.

Our Environment:

We value proactivity and ownership, systems thinking, automation over manual work, and simple reusable solutions over unnecessary complexity. We expect engineering outcomes to be measured rather than asserted.
Our stack:
.NET services and Angular applications
AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform and GitOps (ArgoCD)
GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions
PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Redis and Kafka
OpenTelemetry-aligned observability and Datadog
Internal tooling and developer platform capabilities

You do not need to be an expert in all of it from day one, but you should be comfortable across infrastructure, delivery systems, developer tooling and production environments.

What You`ll Be Doing:

Internal Developer Platform.
Design and build the platform that lets teams create, deploy and operate services with minimal friction. Define and implement golden paths for service creation, CI/CD, observability and infrastructure provisioning. Standardise GitHub workflows, reusable actions, and deployment pipelines.
Self-service infrastructure.
Build self-service infrastructure modules on Terraform and GitOps principles. Create ephemeral environments and local development tooling that cut onboarding time and testing friction.
Reliability, performance, security, and cost by default
. Embed observability, security and compliance into the platform, so teams inherit them rather than implement them. Work with product teams to identify and remove infrastructure and platform bottlenecks that impact product performance, scalability, and reliability. Align standards around SLOs, monitoring and capacity planning, and work with Finance to improve infrastructure cost visibility and efficiency.
AI-assisted engineering enablement.
Turn AI practices into reusable platform capabilities: integrate AI tooling into golden paths and developer workflows and build the guardrails and validation mechanisms that let teams gain speed without losing quality.
Platform as a product.
Own the platform roadmap. Drive adoption of platform capabilities and measure usage, satisfaction, and impact. Improve DORA metrics through systemic platform changes, and contribute to the evolution of modular, scalable systems.
Technical influence.
Lead technical discussions on delivery and infrastructure across teams, review designs, and raise the level of the engineers who build on the platform. Influence through the quality of the paved roads you provide, not through gates.

What You need to Succeed:

Solid experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering at senior level, with strong programming skills (Python, Go or similar).
Strong experience designing CI/CD systems at scale, ideally GitHub Actions, and a deep understanding of Kubernetes and containerised environments.
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and GitOps workflows
A track record of reducing developer friction, with a solid grasp of observability patterns and production readiness.
Experience integrating AI tools into engineering workflows with rigour: clear specs, validated outputs and the same quality bar as manual work.
Ability to influence architecture and delivery decisions across teams, with strong communication and ownership mindset.
